questions.question: Which is not one of the five levels of increasingly effective quality management?
options: Detect and correct defects before the customer finds them
Use quality assurance to examine and correct the process itself
Create a culture committed to quality throughout the organization
Write test cases before writing software code
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 275.

questions.question: All of the following are parts of an effective change management plan EXCEPT
options: Procedures.
Standards for reports.
Meetings.
Lessons learned.
questions.explanation: A change management plan includes the processes and procedures that allow smooth evaluation and tracking of changes. Lessons learned are reviews of the processes and procedures after the fact , to improve them on future projects.

questions.question: What is the BEST technique to ensure the project work is really complete?
options: Final performance reporting
Procurement audits
Archive records
Formal acceptance
questions.explanation: : Only with formal acceptance can the project manger be sure the project work is really complete.

questions.question: A project team has completed, and the customer has accepted, the completed project scope. However, the lesions learned required by the project management office have not been completed. What is the status of the project.
options: The project is incomplete because the project needs to be re-planned.
The project is incomplete until all project and deliverable are complete and accepted.
The project is complete because the customer has accepted the deliverables
The project is complete because the project has reached the due date.
questions.explanation: Re-planning (choice A) is uncalled for by the situation described. A project is complete when all work, including all project management work, is complete and the product of the project, not just deliverables, accepted. The lessons learned are project management deliverables, so choice C cannot be correct. Proper work must be done, not just a date passed, for a project to be complete, so choice D cannot be best.

questions.question: Rearranging resources so that a constant number of resources is used each month is called:
options: Crashing
Floating.
Leveling
Fast tracking
questions.explanation: The key to this question is the phrase “constant number used each month”. Only leveling has such an effect on the schedule.

questions.question: Standard deviation is a measure of how:
options: Far the estimate is from the highest estimate
Far the measurement is from the mean
Correct the sample is
Much timer remains in the project.
questions.explanation: Standard deviation is a measurement of range around the mean.

questions.question: The project status meeting is not going well. Many attendees are talking at the same time, there are people who are not participating, and many topics are being discussed at random. Which of the following rules for effective meetings is NOT being adhered to?
options: Demonstrate courtesy and consideration of each other, and control who is allowed to speak
Schedule meetings in advance
Have a purpose for the meeting, with the right people in attendance
Create and publish an agenda and set a rules for controlling the meeting
questions.explanation: Courtesy and consideration is not a “rule” for effective meetings. Since there is no indication that the meeting was not scheduled in advance or that there isn’t a purpose, these cannot be the best answers. “Discussed at random” implies no agenda. If an agenda is issued before hand, people will follow the outline and should not need random discussions.

questions.question: If the optimistic estimate for an activity is 12 days, and the pessimistic estimate is 18 days, what is the standard deviation of this activity?
questions.explanation: : The standard deviation is computed by (P-O)/6. Therefore (18- 12)/6= (6)/6=1.

questions.question: Barriers can influence communication when sending or receiving information. Which of the following is NOT a barrier?
options: Prejudices
Attitudes and emotions
Personalities and interests
Feedback
questions.explanation: : Feedback is a tool to improve communication, not a communication “blocker” manager to use choice A.

questions.question: A large, complex construction project in a foreign country requires coordination to move the required equipment through crowded city streets. To ensure the equipment is transported successfully, your contact in that country informs you that you will have to pay the local police a fee for coordinating traffic. What should you do?
options: Do not pay the fee because it is a bribe
Eliminate the work
Pay the fee
Do not pay the fee if it is not part of the project estimate.
questions.explanation: This is fee for service paid to a government official and is therefore not a bribe.

questions.question: Projects frequently do not meet customer expectations for which of the following reasons?
options: Poor risk management by the contractor running the project
Poor technical ability of the contractor running the project for the customer
Technical inability and poor risk management by the contractor
Unclear scope definition by the customer for whom the project is performed
questions.explanation: المرجع: Project Management, A Systems Approach to Planning, Scheduling and Controlling by Harold Kerzner, 12th edition, page 593.

questions.question: Crashing describes a technique to speed up a project by…57
options: …reallocating existing resources or assigning additional resources to the project.
…overlapping activities which were originally planned to be done in sequence.
…reducing the number of features of the product in order to reduce development work.
…reducing the duration estimates for activities to increase the pressure applied to the staff.
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 703.

questions.question: What is least important when it comes to archiving project records?
options: A well-designed records management system
Integration of the archive with business software
Updated records reflecting final results
Easy availability of information for future use
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 104.

questions.question: A request, demand or assertion of a contract partner for consideration, compensation or payment under a legally binding contract, such as a disputed change, is often referred to as a____.
options: Claim
Trial
Refinement
Audit
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 498. 98

questions.question: You finished your project for a customer to implement a business software solution. All deliverables have been handed over and are already in use by the company. There is a minor last payment to be made by the customer on contract closure. You believe that it is now getting time to finally close the contract with the customer and then administratively close down the project. You approached the customer this morning and found that they are reluctant to finally close the contract. But you do not exactly understand why. What should you not do?
options: Update all documents related to the project and the product so that they reflect the final specifications and the status of both the project and the product. Organize them in a fashion for easy access.
Focus on your next project and leave the customer the time to get familiar with the software. They will come back to you anyway after some weeks to terminate the contract and make the last payment.
Based on the contract and all documents which are relevant for the formal relationship with the customer, write a close-out report describing what was contractually required and what was obtained.

Make sure that there are no active purchase orders against the contract or any other pending obligations, requests or claims from either party which need to be resolved. Then insist on formal contract closure.
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, pages 127-128. 99

questions.question: What should not be your thoughts when you are organizing documents as lessons learned?
options: Devise the lessons learned documentation in a wording which is easy to understand for a reader who is not familiar with the project.
Lessons learned must detail how certain groups or persons caused failures and delays, especially if they are inside the own organization.
Writing lessons learned should be an exercise enhancing your personal learning experience. Make sure you grasp what you are writing down.
Keep lessons learned documents at a place where they are easy to access and to retrieve for those who may later need the information.
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 104.

questions.question: You are planning quality management for your project. How can a process flowchart help you?
options: It may help identify outliers.
It may help understand the COQ in a process.
It may help spot accountable staff.
It may help react later.
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 323.

questions.question: Which is not an example of a correctly handled contract closure procedure?
options: Early termination of a contract because of a repudiatory breach
Settling and finally closing the contract agreement
Product verification by stakeholders and administrative closure
Early termination of a contract because of an immaterial breach
questions.explanation: المرجع: Project Manager Street Smarts: A Real World Guide to PMP Skills, by Linda Kretz Zaval and Terri A. Wagner, page 669.

questions.question: Which is not a type of project review meeting?
options: Team review meetings
Project status meetings
Executive management review meetings
Customer review meetings
questions.explanation: المرجع: Project Management, A Systems Approach to Planning, Scheduling and Controlling by Harold Kerzner, 12th edition, page 212.

questions.question: Your project work has generally been finished and you want to commence a solid closing process for the project. What must have been attained to begin this process?
options: The deliverables of the project must have been accepted.
The organizational process assets must have been updated.
The final product, service or result transition must have been finished.
Lessons learned must have been organized into a data base.
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 121.

questions.question: What is a product backlog?
options: A description of what is to be delivered in a product
A to-do list of tasks to be finished
A breakdown of scope for an iteration
A time-phased list of technical requirements
questions.explanation: المرجع: PMBOK® Guide 6th Edition, page 131.
